You are the King — you start alone. Drag to steer left and right (or ← → / A D); the run carries you forward. The King fires on his own, always straight ahead, so your job is lane choice and dodging. Damage is pure collision: slip past a body and it costs you nothing. Shoot a gate to raise its number before you cross it. Watch for the orange bomb carriers and the glowing hoarders. Green chips lie where they fall — nothing is pulled in, so steer the crew over them to collect. And when The Grinder comes, kill it before it reaches you — once it takes hold you crawl, and it eats the crew alive.
